title: Word Ladder II
statement: Return all shortest transformation sequences from beginWord to endWord, changing one character at a time and using only dictionary words. Example: hit -> cog with [hot,dot,dog,lot,log,cog] returns [hit,hot,dot,dog,cog] and [hit,hot,lot,log,cog].
approach_name: BFS parent graph then reconstruct shortest paths
space_complexity: O(words × word length + parent graph + output)

title: Single Number
statement: Every integer appears twice except one. Return the unique value in linear time and constant extra space. Examples: [2,2,1] -> 1; [4,1,2,1,2] -> 4; [1] -> 1.

title: Word Break II
statement: Return all sentences formed by inserting spaces so every word belongs to wordDict. Example: s="catsanddog", wordDict=["cat","cats","and","sand","dog"] -> ["cats and dog","cat sand dog"].
approach_name: Memoize sentence suffixes by start index
